sin.name: manual-output-transform
sin.description: A `Data` computed slot hand-flattens a value object into a wire array, instead of a `#[WithTransformer]` that owns the serialized shape
sin.rule: Shape a property's wire output with a `#[WithTransformer]` (+ a matching `#[TypeScriptType]`), never a computed getter that hand-builds the reshaped array.
sin.suggestion: Keep the real value-object type and add `#[WithTransformer(SomeTransformer::class)]` — plus `#[TypeScriptType(...)]` so the generated TypeScript matches the transformed shape.
